name: agent-audit-consulting
icp: Berlin Early AI-dopters (2026-06-17 attendees) with >=1 agent in some running state (prototype or prod)

offer.paragraph: Done-for-you audit of your AI-agent setup. We review your prompts, your tool wiring, and your audit logs; produce a written report naming every place an agent could hallucinate without you catching it; pre-register the failure modes you should be grepping for.
offer.promise: If we find zero auditable risks in your current setup, the audit is free.

loop.title: AI-Agent Audit
loop.headline: Done-for-you audit of your AI-agent setup.
loop.pitch: We review your prompts, your tool wiring, and your audit logs; produce a written report naming every place an agent could hallucinate without you catching it; pre-register the failure modes you should be grepping for.
loop.footer: Delivered async (written report only, no call).
what_you_send: Your prompts (files or a repo URL)
Your tool wiring (which tools the agent calls, how they're configured)
A recent slice of audit / conversation logs (24-48 hours is enough)
One sentence on what your agent is supposed to do
what_you_get: A written report (PDF or markdown) listing every place we found risk of unflagged hallucination, drift, or tool-misuse
A list of pre-registered failure modes — specific patterns to grep your future logs for
Turnaround: 5 business days from intake received

intake_fields.heading: Prompts
items: A link to your prompt files (GitHub repo, Drive folder), OR
Pasted prompts in the email body

intake_fields.heading: Tool wiring
items: Which tools the agent calls (list them by name)
For each tool: brief description of input/output + any guardrails
Link to the MCP server / tool definitions if applicable

intake_fields.heading: Recent logs
items: 24-48 hours of conversation / audit logs (most recent), as a file attachment
Format: JSONL, plain text, or whatever your system emits

intake_fields.heading: Goal
items: One sentence: what is your agent supposed to do?
